skills.description: 通过直连 SubAPI 调用 Grok Imagine，生成图片或短视频并保存到本地。
通过 Sub2API 的 OpenAI 兼容接口生成高分辨率和 4K 图片，支持 TypeScript/Node、流式响应、超时规避、局部图捕获以及本地 API Key 配置文件。
在 Windows PowerShell 中安全检查、更新、修改、冲突处理和提交 Apache Subversion 工作副本。
通过 Codex 自然语言操作 youkia GM，支持账号绑定、项目与功能发现、服务器选择、任务预检、执行和结果查询，并内置 Python 运行环境。
在 Codex 桌面版中配置和使用 Midjourney MCP，解决专用 Chrome 登录、确认表单不可见和生成任务重复提交问题，支持只读验收、经授权出图及原图下载。
通过 Codex 对话配置和管理 youkia 本地服务器，支持开启、关闭、重启、清档及清档重启，自动核验 Unity Play 与服务器状态。
通过 Codex 自然语言查询和操作 Jira，支持账号密码与 Token 登录、任务与 Bug 处理、工作流、报告导出和技能模块抽取，并内置 Python 运行环境。
通过用户自有的 OpenAI 兼容 Sub2API 地址生成或修改高分辨率图片，支持 4K、流式 SSE 解析、本地保存、尺寸检查、错误诊断和安全的离线自测。

Optimize a user's short game-effect idea into a Qwen-Image GMIC skill-icon prompt, generate it through the configured GPU0 ComfyUI API, and produce a traceable WebP preview showing the original input beside the result. Use for GMIC/Qwen game skill icons and effect-icon batches; do not use for character portraits or general image editing.
Generate consistent eight-direction game-character views and labeled 3×3 sheets with a bundled local ComfyUI Qwen Image Edit 2511 workflow.
提供中国卡通风格、45°俯视的竖版仙侠场景绘图标准与复用提示词。
提供中国卡通风格的单体建筑 Prompt 模板、示例与生成检查清单。

Build and validate structured image-generation prompts for game avatar frames. Use when a user wants an avatar-frame prompt, wants to choose among the bundled visual categories, or provides a short Chinese or English avatar-frame concept that needs composition, material, center-opening, and negative constraints. This skill outputs prompts only.

Generate readable 3×3 game skill-icon sheets from character references in LAYERED_2_5D, FLAT_DEPTH_CONTRAST, MONOCHROME_CHIBI_SILHOUETTE, ANIME_CHIBI_RAYLINE, or BOLD_CHIBI_TRICOLOR. Use for character-derived ability icons, style comparison boards, and portable prompt packs across image-capable Agent applications.

Build a fixed 4x4 game-item icon generation prompt from a supported game-art style, a world/theme description, and exactly 16 item descriptions. Use when the user wants Codex to prepare, optimize, assemble, or display a 16-item grid prompt without generating images. Optimize variable content directly with the current Codex model; never call a separate text-model API or rewrite the fixed prompt contract.

Configure and call the Lovart Agent OpenAPI for image, video, audio, 3D, project, thread, upload, download, and model-selection tasks. Use when the user asks to configure Lovart Access Key/Secret Key, test Lovart connectivity, generate or edit media through Lovart, choose a Lovart generation model, or manage Lovart projects and conversations.
